title: Low Oil Pressure Warning
shortDescription: SmartCraft reports oil pressure below safe threshold.
fullDescription: Sea Ray boats with MerCruiser engines display SC-101 when oil pressure drops below the alarm setpoint. Engine may enter Guardian mode and limit RPM.

fixSteps.title: Check oil level
fixSteps.instruction: Verify oil on dipstick with boat level.

fixSteps.title: Test sender
fixSteps.instruction: Use mechanical gauge at sender port to verify actual pressure.

fixSteps.title: Replace sender
fixSteps.instruction: Install new oil pressure sender if mechanical gauge reads normal.

whenToCallPro: If actual oil pressure is low, engine work needed.
videoSearchQuery: Sea Ray SmartCraft low oil pressure

faq.a: No; shut down to avoid engine damage.

title: Engine Overheat
fullDescription: Sea Ray boats display SC-102 when ECT exceeds threshold. Guardian mode limits RPM to protect the engine.

fixSteps.title: Check intake
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect raw-water strainer and through-hull for debris.

fixSteps.title: Replace impeller
fixSteps.instruction: Remove sea-water pump cover and replace impeller.

fixSteps.title: Test thermostat
fixSteps.instruction: Pull thermostat and test in hot water.

whenToCallPro: If heat exchanger or block work needed.

faq.a: No; severe block damage can result.

title: Low Battery Voltage
fullDescription: Battery voltage at the ECU is below 11.5V running. Affects sensors, fuel pump, and ignition.

fixSteps.title: Test battery
fixSteps.instruction: Load test battery; replace if it fails.

faq.a: Sea Ray boats often have separate start and house banks; check both.

title: Water in Fuel
shortDescription: Water-in-fuel sensor in fuel filter triggered.
fullDescription: Water has accumulated in the engine-mounted fuel filter. Engine may run rough or stall.

fixSteps.title: Drain filter
fixSteps.instruction: Open drain valve on the water-separating filter.

fixSteps.title: Treat tank
fixSteps.instruction: Add fuel water absorber and refuel from a clean source.

faq.a: If contamination is heavy, professional polishing is recommended.

title: MAP Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Manifold pressure sensor signal out of range.
fullDescription: MerCruiser engine MAP sensor signal invalid. ECU uses default fueling, reducing performance.

fixSteps.title: Inspect hose
fixSteps.instruction: Check vacuum line to MAP sensor on intake.

fixSteps.title: Probe sensor
fixSteps.instruction: 5V reference, ground, and signal all present.

faq.a: Yes at reduced power; repair before next outing.

title: Drive Lube Low
fullDescription: Drive lubricant level in the remote reservoir below sensor; sterndrive may be losing oil.

fixSteps.title: Check reservoir
fixSteps.instruction: Check level in drive lube monitor bottle in engine bay.

fixSteps.title: Inspect drive
fixSteps.instruction: Look at drive housing for oil weep or milky color.

whenToCallPro: If pressure test fails, drive removal is needed.

faq.a: Top off temporarily; have leak diagnosed quickly to prevent water intrusion.

title: TPS Signal Fault
shortDescription: Throttle position sensor out of range.
fullDescription: DTS throttle controller reports TPS fault; engine may stay at idle (Guardian mode).

fixSteps.title: Cycle ignition
fixSteps.instruction: Turn key off 60s, then on with throttle in idle.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Check DTS harness from helm to engine.

fixSteps.title: Replace TPS/throttle body
fixSteps.instruction: Install new throttle body or TPS module.

faq.a: Boat may be limited to idle; tow-in advised.

title: Knock Detected
fullDescription: Knock sensor reports detonation. ECU retards timing; may indicate bad fuel or carbon buildup.

fixSteps.title: Refuel premium
fixSteps.instruction: Refill with 91+ octane non-ethanol if available.

fixSteps.title: Replace knock sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Replace sensor on engine block if codes persist.

whenToCallPro: If knock continues with quality fuel.

faq.a: Continued knock can damage pistons; resolve quickly.

title: Trim Sender Fault
shortDescription: Drive trim position sensor out of range.
fullDescription: Trim gauge reads erratically or pegged. Auto-trim disabled.

fixSteps.title: Inspect at gimbal
fixSteps.instruction: Look for chafe at trim sender harness near gimbal ring.

fixSteps.title: Test sender
fixSteps.instruction: Resistance should sweep 10-160 ohms across full trim range.

fixSteps.title: Replace sender
fixSteps.instruction: Install new sender and adjust per manual.

whenToCallPro: If drive must be tilted clear for access.

faq.a: Yes, hydraulic trim still functions; only the gauge is affected.

title: Bus Communication Fault
fullDescription: VesselView or gauges have lost CAN communication with ECU. Often a wiring or terminator issue.

fixSteps.title: Inspect connectors
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat all SmartCraft junction blocks and 4-pin connectors.

fixSteps.title: Verify terminators
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm terminator resistors on both bus ends.

whenToCallPro: If VesselView head replacement is suspected.

faq.a: Yes, but without instrumentation; head back at low RPM.
